now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
now.text: Ego hired Yondu's crew, Kraglin included, to bring him Peter Quill, and Kraglin and Yondu later agree it was for the best that they never did. When the Guardians fight Ego, Kraglin flies the ship that carries them off his dying planet.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager in the crew Ego hired to bring him Quill.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Quill's father, who hired Yondu's crew. Kraglin flies the Guardians off the dying planet.

proposed.text: Ego once hired Yondu's crew, Kraglin included, to bring him Peter Quill. When the Guardians fight Ego, Kraglin flies the ship that carries them off his dying planet.

changes.evidence: Kraglin and Yondu's talk about it being a good thing they never delivered Quill to the man who hired them is the closing scene of Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), after the Battle of Xandar, not a later moment in Vol. 2 (and Ego is not named there). The rest of the text holds for Vol. 2.

stages.title: WandaVision#3
stages.text: Tommy is the nephew of Pietro Maximoff, Wanda's twin brother who died in Sokovia.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tommy's uncle, his mother's twin, who died in Sokovia.

stages.title: WandaVision#6
stages.text: Tommy turns out to share his late uncle's super speed.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Pietro's nephew, Wanda's son, who shares his speed.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tommy's uncle, his mother's speedster twin.

changes.evidence: A blood tie never met. Pietro dies in Sokovia in Avengers: Age of Ultron; Tommy only exists from WandaVision#3 inside the Hex. The 'Pietro' who meets the twins in Westview (WandaVision#5-#8) is Ralph Bohner, a separate file (ralph-bohner). Tommy's speed resembling Pietro's is not a meeting or a dealing between them, and the owner's rule lists a blood tie never met as staying out.

proposed.title: Loki S1#2
proposed.text: When the TVA corners Sylvie at a Roxxcart in 2050 Alabama, she enchants Hunter B-15 and speaks through her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The variant who enchants B-15 at the Roxxcart.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A TVA hunter Sylvie enchants at the Roxxcart.

changes.evidence: Missing opening stage before stage 0: they first meet as enemies in Loki S1#2 'The Variant', where the Variant enchants several locals and Hunter B-15 during the 2050 Alabama ambush. The ally turn then comes in S1#4, where the existing stage sits (its text already refers back to the Roxxcart).

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#16
proposed.text: Victoria Hand and John Garrett work together on Coulson's hunt for the Clairvoyant. Hand dismisses Garrett's plan and tells him not to call her Vic.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A senior agent who doubts Garrett's plan to catch the Clairvoyant.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A veteran agent whose Clairvoyant plan Hand dismisses.

changes.evidence: Missing opening stage before stage 0: in S1#16 'End of the Beginning' Hand is briefed aboard the Bus by Coulson, Garrett and Triplett, then back at the Hub shoots down Garrett's defence of the plan and orders him not to call her 'Vic'. They turn enemies in S1#17, where the existing stage sits.
